reason: Most of my runs are on the gym treadmill after work, so a GPS route app has almost nothing to record, and my crew already runs fine off a KakaoTalk open chat. Virtual shoes and points I can't cash out don't pull me in either.
objection: It's another app that wants my location the whole time I run, and it's Android-only, so half my crew with iPhones couldn't even join the crew run.
would_change_my_mind: If my whole crew, iPhone people included, agreed to use it for our weekly meetups, and it counted my treadmill runs too.
